gen-almendra-display-gf-jaldi: Almendra Display brings an ornate, bookish flourish with letters that never pinch shut, while Jaldi sits below in a brushed, tightly packed sans. Its tall lowercase keeps the text readable.
gen-almendra-display-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Ornate meets modern here. Almendra Display carries the literary flourish up top, and Kdam Thmor Pro fills the lines beneath with round, full-bowled sans-serif letters that feel current.
gen-almendra-display-gf-krona-one: Krona One takes the body with loosely spaced letters, its lowercase as hefty as cast iron capitals. Almendra Display above it keeps the ornate, literary flourish, so the sans below feels sturdy by comparison.
gen-almendra-display-gf-magra: Magra reads big-bodied, even in lowercase. Almendra Display opens above it with literary ornament and letters that never pinch shut, leaving the sans-serif text feeling sturdy and businesslike.
gen-almendra-display-gf-major-mono-displ: Major Mono Display reads like neon glass: a tube-like monospace stroke, wide sidebearings, and curves that sweep open. Then Almendra Display enters with ornate, literary letters, its strokes varying where the monospace line never does.
gen-almendra-display-gf-martian-mono: Martian Mono reads as structured, code-style monospace, with fixed-width letters spread far apart and generous openings in every curve. Almendra Display, ornate and literary, varies its stroke where this body keeps a marker-like line.
gen-almendra-display-gf-matemasie: Matemasie brings broad gaps between glyphs and small entry points into its round letters, giving the sans-serif a closed, tidy look. Almendra Display above stays open and ornate, so each font's shapes feel distinct.
gen-almendra-display-gf-menbere: Menbere stacks its lowercase tall, like rolled cord, in a clean sans. Almendra Display sits above it, ornate and literary, with letters that never seem to pinch shut.
gen-almendra-display-gf-mitr: Mitr reads compact and approachable, with almost no gap between its x-height and cap height. Almendra Display, ornate and literary, sits above it with a pronounced x-height and letters that never pinch shut.
gen-almendra-display-gf-momo-trust-displ: Almendra Display opens the pair with ornate, literary letters that never seem to pinch shut. Momo Trust Display follows as a plain sans, its distant, drifting letters and generous x-height giving the pair real breathing space.
